replacementBoundaries: UART CDC/native50MHz UART and CMU CDC/native50MHz CMU -> external one-credit register services
GMAC media/CDC frame/config/rate/stop/counter/level interfaces -> explicit CPU-domain services
RGMII/PHY pins -> frame service and Clause22 MDIO pad responder
asynchronous cold-reset assertion -> synchronous assertion with three CPU release stages
MIG/UI250MHz/DDR device -> unchanged independent-RW R32/B32 AXI service

limitations: About 0.5% throughput, not a major solved bottleneck.
Original independent-RW and fixed whole-burst laws are separate experiments.
Native declared state +66 total bits (+147 scalar, -81 array); not mapped FF, area, power or STA.
FP backend execution and physical board/MIG timing were not exercised.

qualified_service_laws.fixed: newest eligible at returned-burst boundaries; fixed ID through actual LAST fire
qualified_service_laws.original: independent R/W R32/B32; original selected ID may interleave beats
